content: Hudai Wiliechi
Gaijiula, bi eqighandei tande kielien kieliekude tai ruhhernughun danlagha dazhi beyenughun danlaghazho. Mexihai miende tai yeliwa mutun uzhezho.
Bi tande budan ese qiezhezhi neizi qiezhekushi ta budanyi ijie dane, edeliuzhe ijie dane.
Tashi beyenughun wo. Tai sudoro dubilieku, jianjinduku wine. Eneshi beyenughun pushonu? Zhao duyani kunla giesan mutun ese giezhou?
Niezhan kunla kieliese bi Baoloni daghazho. Niezhan kunla kieliese bi Yaboloi daghazho giezho. Ingiezhi ta duyai kunlare niekielien pushonu?
Yaboloshi kien wo? Baoloshi kien wo? Manshi wiliechi wo, zhao Ezhan nieniede ogisan renwughala tai xianxin gieghasan wo.
Bi tareiwo, Yabolo usu teiwo, osighasanshi Huda wo.
Ingiese tareisan, usu kiesan yama pusho, zinie osighasan Huda hen wo.
Tareisan, usu kiesanghala niekielien wo, zhao nieniede wilie giesan mutun gunzi ogine.
Bijienshi hhantu wilie giesan Hudai wiliechi wo. Tashi Hudai ghazha, mechi wo.
Zhao Huda made ogisan nenjienghala bi nie hen guntou mutun jichui daizho, psedu kun jiereni gie giezhoma, jien kun matugie giekui xioxin gie.
Ene dai goudaghasan jichushi Ersa Mexiha wo, psedu jichui kiemada dai dane.
Ene jichu jiere kienliuzhe antan, miengu, boushi, mutun, osun, ghuyughala gie giese
panjiku udude jien kunla giesei xienjizhi khizheghane, khanghala khizheghane. Goya giesanla matugiezho giezhi ene khan shiine.
Gie giesan kun hhe jichu jiere giesan bei shidase hhende jianli ogine.
Giesanni sidera widase hhe kuiine. Hhei jiuinema, jiuiku hoxian khan dundase holu khizheku niekielien wo.
Tashi Hudai dajien bikui, pse Hudai ruhher tai sudoro sousanyi ta ulie mejienu?
Kien Hudai dajienyi qida olughase Huda hhe kunyi qida olughane. Hudai dajienshi zhiguitu wo, tashi ene dajien wo.
Kienliuzhe goyane bu pienda. Tai dunda kun goyane ene duyade agheli wine giezhi sumulase benni gholu. Ingiese aghelitu gholune.
Ene duyani aghelii Huda uzhese benni wo. Jinwun jiere jilasan mutun,

content.text: "Ezhan aghelitu kunlai jienzhanii hhelai bareiku on gholughawo."

content: Pse huaizho,

content.text: "Aghelitu kunlai sumulaku yama isi witui Ezhan mejiene."

content: Ingiese kienliuzhe kunni bu kuai, yanliuzhe manshi tanughun wo.
Baolo, Yabolo, Jifa, duya, amituku, fuguku, edeku shiqin, jianlaiku shiqin manshi tanughun wo.
Tashi Mexihanughun wo, Mexihashi Hudanughun wo.
